lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are organized into approximately four vertical columns immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit. These centroids exhibit a semi-regular grid-like distribution on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting the rows of circular blobs to form defined nodes of peak luminance, particularly evident in the region between the gills and the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light pixels on the dorsal side to a shadowed region on the ventral side, extending from above the gills towards the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: The anterior region of the specimen transitions from large, sparse blobs into a high-density field of significantly smaller, high-luminance points as the surface curves towards the snout.
